status: Working plan for the clarity pass on all nine Series 2 scripts. It does not change the bible, any beat, shot, frame, the story, either ending, the choice question or its labels. Every draft line here is a default under D-024 ruling 1.7: the writers (S2 Hindi, S5 English) may use it or write a better one that carries the same fact.
how_to_read: episodes[] is in story order: shared s2e01, s2e02, s2e03, then branch A s2a01 to s2a03, then branch B s2b01 to s2b03. Path A = shared + A; path B = shared + B.

Each episode lists must_know_by_end: the facts a first-time viewer needs by the end of that episode to follow the next one (for the two finales, to understand the ending). Each fact names the beat and line, or super, that will carry it.

op values: keep (the line already carries it; leave it), reword (same id, new words), add (new line inside the same beat, with the id given), mark (set heard_as), super (orientation super in the beat's supers list), move (same beat, to the speaker's own shot).

fault_now quotes the cold-viewer reports (docs/clarity-cold-viewers.md) or the clarity review (docs/clarity-review.md). A fact with no fault_now already lands; it is listed so that C1 and S4 can check it is not lost in the rewrite.
must_not_know_yet lists what the viewer must still not know at that point. Those items come from bible locks and the glimpses' must_not_reveal lists, and no clarity line may give them away.
Hindi drafts follow the script convention: Devanagari for Hindi words and names, Latin for English words and acronyms. English drafts are Indian English for the same cast.
